review_evidence: README describes a SageMath integration pipeline translating Lean expressions to Sage, executing Sage externally, translating results back, and providing sage tactics/commands.
Production modules implement AST translation, MathML conversion, proof-builder/tactic plumbing, and the Sage process bridge.

The only named theorem declarations found are two Main.lean demonstrations (poly_factorization and poly_integration), alongside tactic demo/test statements; there is no separately developed verified semantics or mathematical theorem corpus.
